purpose: Define independent fresh-review batches, required checks and promotion boundaries for the 24 locally reviewed C2-LT-B12 source-context extraction rows without storing verdicts inside the protocol artifact.

scope.selectionRule: Every C2-LT-B12 local-review row must receive independent fresh review before any reviewed artifact, advice-use, intervention-ranking or model-admission claim.
nonClaims: This protocol is not an independent fresh review verdict register.
This protocol does not complete Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade-check artifacts.

This protocol does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, domain-claim upgrade, clinical-validity claims, clinical advice, screening advice, drug advice, biologic advice, cell-therapy advice, biosecurity advice, radiation-emergency advice, infection-control advice, occupational-exposure advice, urogenital-care advice, allergy-care advice, eye-care advice, hearing-care advice, speech-therapy advice or rehabilitation advice.

promotionRules: support-with-boundary or bounded-support may proceed only to eligible-for-bounded-artifact-fill, never directly to model admission, intervention ranking, advice use or clinical-validity claims.
downgrade-required rows must carry a downgrade note before artifact fill and remain blocked for calibrated prediction, individual advice and all C2-LT-B12 advice-use categories.
reject-source-context-mismatch rows must not fill reviewed artifacts until source identity, source role or source context is corrected and independently checked.
cannot-evaluate-insufficient-context rows remain blocked until a primary or authoritative source can be independently checked.
Artifact promotion decisions are limited to eligible-for-bounded-artifact-fill, downgrade-before-fill, rejected-no-fill and blocked-cannot-evaluate.

reviewBatches.batchLabel: 工程化细胞疗法、类器官/器官芯片、生物安全、辐射核安全、消毒灭菌和血源暴露连续性域
reviewBatches.reviewFocus: independent fresh review must verify engineered cell therapy, organoid/tissue-chip, synthetic biology biosecurity, radiation/nuclear safety, sterilization/disinfection and bloodborne exposure source scope; no cell-therapy, biosecurity, radiation-emergency, infection-control, occupational-exposure or clinical advice and no artifact promotion before independent verdicts
